info.title: infiniFi Data (Pocket Network service)
info.description: Read-only pass-through to the infiniFi protocol API (api.infinifi.xyz), served on Pocket Network as service `infinifi`. Every input is a JSON body; every response, errors included, is a JSON object. APYs are fractions (0.062 = 6.2%); token amounts are whole tokens. The service never signs, prepares, or submits a transaction. Not affiliated with infiniFi.

get.summary: Readiness: ok while the infiniFi protocol data can be served
